high_level_description: The image is divided into two sections. On the left side, there is a scene of a road that has been severely damaged by what appears to be an earthquake. A white van is partially submerged in a large sinkhole or crack in the road surface. The road is wet, suggesting recent rain or melting snow, as there are patches of snow visible around the sinkhole. Several traffic cones are placed around the area, likely to warn passersby of the danger. Three individuals are standing near the sinkhole, observing the damage.
